pre_mortem: The solver reads DRP-4, fixes the nine departures and writes a reference from the procedure, then fuzzes the package against it. Fixing 4.2 at the fill loop, the natural rewrite fills every substitute hour from the valid hours either side, because the shipped loop treats every non-valid hour alike; its reference does the same unless it reads 2.5 as the boundary of 4.2 and asks what an hour with some valid readings reports. Fixing 3.2, the one-line edit is AMBIENT_O2 = 209, which also moves the valid hours at 19 per cent oxygen or more; its reference writes the 3.2 formula for every valid hour unless it reads 2.4. Self-fuzzing shares both choices, so neither over-reach shows. Cycle-1 showed the silence clause plus definitions let both solvers keep both traps by adding branches beside old code; the strengthening moves each kept value onto a shared constant (O2_CAP) or a shared carry variable whose natural edit silently changes it.

score_notes.restraint_traps: two traps where the minimal natural fix breaks the silent case (rewritten loop; shared constant), different nodes and kinds, each bounded by a section 2 definition; one reading policy (read each rule's subject through its definition and keep today's step outside it) still disarms both
score_notes.fuzz_blind_spot: T1 needs an operating hour with mixed codes that fails 2.3 without a CAL allowance; T2 needs a valid hour whose oxygen average reaches 190; a solver's own draws may hit both but its reference encodes the same choice

decisive_reason: each kept value now depends on a constant or carry the departure's natural repair edits, so a solver who believes it preserved today's code still changes it
